portfolio.program_goal: Up to 5 world-class inventions via push-the-envelope methodology
portfolio.slot_rule: A slot is earned only when: problem exists → evidence survives → prior art survives → strongest alternative survives → physics survives → experiment survives → buyer value survives. Five slots is a CEILING on active attention, not a quota requiring five inventions.
portfolio.note: A slot counts as a world-class invention ONLY when ALL of: ENGINEERING=SURVIVOR, PATENT=SEARCH_COMPLETE_OR_COUNSEL_CLEARED, EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY=COMPLETE, DOSSIER=READY, BUYER_VALUE=SURVIVES. Currently 0 slots meet all five.

pipeline_structure.identifiability: PRE-CHECK PASSES — obstruction has distinct temporal signature (sustained) vs posture (transient) vs cough (brief) vs drift (monotonic). #1 V25 collinearity does NOT apply — temporal patterns provide orthogonal information.

slot_earning_rule.rule: A slot is earned only when ALL of the following survive:
gates: 1. problem_exists — Article XX problem-existence gate passes GREEN (not YELLOW)
2. evidence_survives — Article XXI discovery evidence with per-record relevance adjudication
3. prior_art_survives — §102/§103 patent gate with exact claim language, not abstract similarity
4. strongest_alternative_survives — Article XXXII strongest-alternative attack does not make the candidate unnecessary
5. physics_survives — model-derived conclusions survive harder physics attacks
6. experiment_survives — physical experiment confirms the model (EMBODIMENT-level, not just model-level)
7. buyer_value_survives — buyer-value test passes (morbidity, mortality, regulatory, commercial)
slot_earning_rule.failure_mode: If ANY gate fails, the candidate does NOT earn a slot. The slot remains empty.
slot_earning_rule.anti_quota_principle: Five slots is a CEILING on active attention, not a quota requiring five inventions. World-class inventions completed: 0 / 5. That is the right number to chase now.
